name: ai-planner
description: AI Planner — privacy-focused PWA that digitizes handwritten planner pages with Gemini.

scripts.test:e2e: cd e2e && npx playwright test tests/sync.spec.js --project=chromium
scripts.test:e2e:smoke: cd e2e && CI=true npx playwright test tests/sync.spec.js tests/ui.spec.js --project=chromium
scripts.test:e2e:ui: cd e2e && npx playwright test tests/ui.spec.js --project=chromium
scripts.test:contract: cd e2e && npx playwright test tests/staging-contract.spec.js --project=chromium
scripts.quality:ci: npm run check:conflicts && npm run test:frontend && npm run test:backend && npm run test:mobile && npm run test:e2e:smoke
scripts.test:all: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend && npm run test:mobile && npm run test:e2e:smoke
scripts.test:mobile: cd mobile && npm run lint && npm test
scripts.setup:hooks: git config core.hooksPath scripts/git-hooks && echo "Git hooks installed (scripts/git-hooks)."
